title: Check the results of the Federal Lottery draw 6094
subtitle: Caixa Econômica Federal held the Federal Lottery draw for contest 6094-1 on August 23, 2026.
excerpt: Check the drawn numbers and winning tickets for contest 6094 of the Federal Lottery held by Caixa Econômica Federal.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Caixa Econômica Federal held the Federal Lottery draw for contest 6094-1 on August 23, 2026, at Espaço da Sorte, in São Paulo (SP). The event generated searches for the result, attracting the attention of bettors interested in checking the winning tickets of the draw.

Drawn tickets and main prizes

The tickets drawn in contest 6094 of the Federal Lottery held this Sunday awarded five main bets with specific values. The order from the first to the fifth prize distributed the following amounts:

  • 1st - Ticket 013000: R$ 500,000
  • 2nd - Ticket 009559: R$ 35,000
  • 3rd - Ticket 082213: R$ 30,000
  • 4th - Ticket 091203: R$ 25,000
  • 5th - Ticket 087095: R$ 20,503

How the Federal Lottery works

In the Federal Lottery, the bettor purchases a pre-numbered ticket, which can be whole or in fractions, without the option of choosing numbers individually. The player must choose the ticket displayed at the lottery retail shop or buy it from a vendor authorized by Caixa. The amount received by the bettor is proportional to the number of fractions purchased of the winning ticket.

Derived prizes and rules

In addition to the main prize, the Federal Lottery distributes derived prizes for tickets with specific criteria. Among them are the thousand, hundred, and ten of any of the numbers drawn in the five main prizes. Tickets whose numbers correspond to the approximation immediately before and after the number drawn for the first prize are also awarded.

Other prize tiers include tickets with final tens identical to one of the three tens before or the three tens after the ten of the number drawn for the first prize, in addition to the unit of the first prize. The gross prizes of the Federal Lottery correspond to 60% of the collection.

Prize collection and modalities

Prizes with net values up to R$ 1,700.16 can be collected at any lottery shop or Caixa branch, while higher prizes must be collected exclusively at a branch. The Federal Lottery has four draw modalities: Quartou, held on Wednesdays; Sunday Draw; Enricou, a monthly special draw; and Christmas Special, an annual draw.
